consumer: The GUI tile/map draw path that asks 'what threat color does the engine display this visible monster as?' so the frontend can reproduce it
scope: The displayed per-tile threat tint for each visible monster, as the GUI's draw layer would render it
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities (monsters) — emits raw hp/hp_max/moves/hallucination engine getters, i.e. raw simulation state, not the engine's threat-to-color display computation
divergence: A near-dead high-threat monster (e.g. a zombie hulk at 1/500 hp) still displays its high-threat tint because the color follows the threat/danger rating, not the hp ratio; reconstructing a tint from hp/hp_max (~0%) would mis-color it as harmless, and a full-hp hallucination would be tinted as a real threat
